line.en: Mounted slides on a glowing light table, compared side by side, slid over each other and searched with a loupe, marked in grease pencil.
line.zh-CN: 发光看片台上的装框幻灯片：并排对比、叠放推入、放大镜细看，用油性笔圈出变化。

for.en: Before-and-after films of something you can picture: repairs, restorations, cleaning, edits, design revisions, stages of a change; with the maker's own pictures or clips in the slides.
for.zh-CN: 能用画面呈现的前后对比：修复、翻新、清洁、修图与设计改版、变化的各个阶段；幻灯片里放制作者自己的图片或视频。

not.en: Abstract ideas or numbers with nothing to look at; long arguments. A film with no pictures of its own will look empty.
not.zh-CN: 没有画面可看的抽象概念或数字；长篇论证。没有自己画面的片子会显得空。
